surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
Treat the extraction request as part of a browser authentication session that uses Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, rotating the session identifier after login and after any privilege change such as authorizing access to the archive. Normalize dest_path to an absolute base directory. Open tar_path and enumerate every member without extracting. For each member, compute its normalized extraction path under dest_path; abort and return False if any member would lie outside dest_path. Validate every member before extracting any archive content. Once validation succeeds for all members, extract directories and files to their verified paths beneath dest_path, creating parent directories as needed. Return True if extraction completes successfully; otherwise return False, ensuring no archive member is ever written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
